description: List your YourImageShare uploads, newest first, 50 per page - use this to find an upload's `id` when you only have its URL or remember it by content. Each result has the same link fields as upload_image plus `created_at`. An out-of-range page returns an empty `data` array.
name: list_uploads

direct.description: The shareable page URL (title, description, comments, share buttons). Despite the field name, this is NOT a direct file link - use `src` for that.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 auto-delete timestamp, or null if the upload never expires.

height.description: Height in pixels, or null if unknown.

id.description: Unique identifier for this upload. Pass to get_upload / update_upload / delete_upload.

locked.description: True if the upload is password-protected.

path.description: Storage URL of the file as uploaded. It can change shortly afterwards when the file is converted (WebP/MP4) - store `src` instead.

size.description: File size in bytes as stored.

src.description: Permanent direct/embeddable file URL - use this for /

thumb.description: 280px wide WebP thumbnail (for a video, its first frame), or null.

visibility.description: private: file only, no page for others. unlisted: file and page work for anyone with the link. public: listed on the site.

width.description: Width in pixels, or null if unknown.

title: List your uploads
